Rashi on Niddah 45a:10:1.english: Woe for the three years that I lost - From when I was fit for intercourse.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:11:1.hebrew: משמשות במוך - תקנתן הוה לשמש במוך, שלא יתעברו:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:11:1.english: Engage in intercourse with an absorbent cloth - Their remedy is to engage in intercourse with an absorbent cloth, so that they will not become pregnant.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:12:1.hebrew: סנדל - כשמתעברת תאומים, פעמים שאחד דוחק את חבירו ופוחת את צורתו, כדאמרינן במכילתין: אין סנדל שאין עמו ולד:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:12:1.english: A sandal - When [a woman] becomes pregnant with twins, at times one presses against the other and diminishes its form, as we say in our tractate: "There is no sandal that does not have [another] fetus with it."

Rashi on Niddah 45a:12:2.english: She will wean - She will separate her child from nursing due to her pregnancy.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:13:1.hebrew: פחות מכן - אינה צריכה לשמש במוך, דודאי לא תתעבר:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:13:1.english: Less than this - She does not need to engage in intercourse with an absorbent cloth, for she will certainly not become pregnant.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:13:2.hebrew: יתר על כן - אם תתעבר, לא תמות:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:13:2.english: Older than that - If she becomes pregnant, she will not die.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:17:1.hebrew: מצצה - כלומר, אף אני טעמתי טעם זנות:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:17:1.english: He sucked it - That is to say: I too tasted the taste of illicit intercourse.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:18:1.hebrew: לא אמרה - הא דקאמר פסולה לכהונה, אלא לחדד:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:18:1.english: He did not say it - That which he said, "[She is] disqualified from the priesthood," [was] only to sharpen [the students].

Rashi on Niddah 45a:19:1.hebrew: קנאה - וזכה בנכסי אחיו, ואע"ג שאין קנין לקטן, הרי קנויה לו ועומדת:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:19:1.english: He acquires her - And he gains title to his brother's property. And even though a minor cannot effect an acquisition, behold, she is already acquired to him and stands [so].

Rashi on Niddah 45a:19:2.hebrew: ואינו נותן גט עד שיגדיל - אם בא לגרשה, דקידושי אחיו קידושין גמורין, וגירושין של זה אינם גירושין גמורין, דאינו בן דעת:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:19:2.english: And he does not give a bill of divorce until he reaches majority - [This applies] if he comes to divorce her, for his brother's betrothal was a complete betrothal, and the divorce of this [minor] is not a complete divorce, as he is not legally competent.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:1:1.hebrew: בשלמא לרבי יוחנן - דאמר מכי איקלע חשיבות שנה בשנה שלישית, לרבי מאיר הויא בת ביאה, ניחא. ואע"ג דאמר רבי יוחנן ל' יום, והכא קתני יום אחד, תנאי היא בפרק ארבעה ראשי שנים (ר"ה דף י.), דאיכא למ"ד יום אחד בשנה חשוב שנה, ואיכא למאן דאמר כו':
Rashi on Niddah 45a:1:1.english: Granted, according to Rabbi Yoḥanan - Who said that once a significant portion of a year occurs in the third year, according to Rabbi Meir she is fit for intercourse, [it is] well understood. And even though Rabbi Yoḥanan said thirty days, whereas here [the baraita] teaches one day, it is [a dispute between] Tannaim in the chapter "Arba'ah Rashei Shanim" (Rosh Hashanah 10a), as there is one who says: "One day in a year is considered a year," and there is one who says, etc.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:20:1.hebrew: ומטמא בנדה - אם בא עליה, דביאתו ביאה לכל דבר:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:20:1.english: And he becomes ritually impure through a menstruating woman - If he has intercourse with her, for his intercourse is [considered] intercourse with regard to all matters.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:21:1.hebrew: ופוסל - כגון בן ט' שנים כותי או ממזר שבא על הכהנת, פסלה מתרומת אביה. אבל בבן תשע ישראל שבא על בת כהן, ליכא למימר דפוסל מן התרומה: דאי משום ביאת זנות — לא פסלה זנות דכשר מן התרומה; ואי משום קדושין, למהוי בת כהן לישראל — לאו קדושין נינהו, דקטן דקדיש אין קדושיו קדושין:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:21:1.english: And he disqualifies - For example, a nine-year-old Cuthean or mamzer who engaged in intercourse with the daughter of a priest, he has disqualified her from her father's terumah. But in [the case of] a nine-year-old Israelite who engaged in intercourse with the daughter of a priest, it cannot be said that he disqualifies [her] from terumah: For if [it were] because of licentious intercourse, licentious intercourse with an eligible [man] does not disqualify [her] from terumah; and if [it were] because of betrothal, so that she becomes a priest's daughter [married] to an Israelite, this is not betrothal, as [when] a minor betroths, his betrothal is not valid.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:21:2.hebrew: ואינו מאכיל - כגון יבם בן ט' כהן הבא על יבמתו, אע"ג דקני לה בהך ביאה, לא אכלה בתרומה:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:21:2.english: And he does not enable [her] to eat - For example, a nine-year-old yavam who is a priest, who engages in intercourse with his yevama — even though he acquired her through this act of intercourse, she does not eat terumah.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:21:3.hebrew: ופוסל את הבהמה - אם רבעה ע"פ עד אחד או ע"פ הבעלים, אבל סקילה לא, דמודה בקנס פטור:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:21:3.english: And he disqualifies the animal - If he had relations with it based on [the testimony of] a single witness or based on [the admission of] the owner; but stoning does not [apply], for one who admits to a fine is exempt.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:21:4.english: And it is stoned on his account - If there are witnesses.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:22:1.hebrew: בגט סגיא לה - בתמיה, אם בא לגרשה:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:22:1.english: Is a bill of divorce sufficient for her - [This is asked] in astonishment: If he comes to divorce her [does a bill of divorce suffice]?

Rashi on Niddah 45a:23:1.english: Levirate betrothal - The betrothal of a yevama.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:23:2.hebrew: וחליצה לזיקתו - דאין קדושין גומרין ביבמה להיות כאשתו לצאת בגט בלא חליצה, אבל ביאה גומרת בה, כדכתי' (דברים כה) יבא עליה:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:23:2.english: And ḥalitza for his levirate bond - For betrothal does not complete [the acquisition of] a yevama to become like his wife, to leave with a bill of divorce without ḥalitza; but intercourse completes [the acquisition of] her, as it is written (Deuteronomy 25): "[Her husband's brother] shall go in unto her."

Rashi on Niddah 45a:23:3.english: The levirate union of a nine-year-old - With his yevama [his deceased brother's widow].

Rashi on Niddah 45a:2:1.hebrew: אלא לרבי ינאי - דאמר לר"מ עד סוף שנה שלישית לאו בת ביאה היא, קשיא:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:2:1.english: But according to Rabbi Yannai - Who said that according to Rabbi Meir, until the end of the third year she is not capable of intercourse, [it is] difficult.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:3:1.english: These signs of virginity - Within three years [of age].

Rashi on Niddah 45a:3:2.hebrew: איתצוד - לשון צידה, כלומר: אינן ניטלין על ידי ביאה, ואינו דם בתולין עד ג' שנים ויום אחד:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:3:2.english: Are trapped - An expression of trapping. That is to say, they are not removed through intercourse, and [the blood] is not virginity blood, until three years and one day.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:4:1.hebrew: אי אמרת מיזל אזלי - בביאה בתוך ג' לגמרי, והדר אתו — לא מחזקינן לה כזונה. דהא דלא הדור — שהות הוא דלא הויא להו, מתוך בעילה שבעל תדיר:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:4:1.english: If you say they disappear - [I.e., through] intercourse within three [years they disappear] completely, and then return — we do not presume her to be a zona. For as for the fact that they did not return, there was not [sufficient] time for them [to return], due to the frequent intercourse he engaged in.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:5:1.hebrew: אלא אי אמרת - לא אזלי בביאה תוך ג', הוה ליה למיתי דם לאחר ג'. וכיון דלא חזיא, אחר בא עליה לאחר ג', וזונה היא ופסולה לכהונה:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:5:1.english: But if you say - [That the hymen] does not disappear through intercourse within three [years], blood should have come after three [years]. And since she did not see [blood], another [man] had intercourse with her after three [years], and she is a zonah and disqualified from the priesthood.

Rashi on Niddah 45a:6:1.hebrew: ומאן לימא לן - כלומר, אפי' אם תמצי לומר מיזל אזלי בביאה תוך ג', מי איכא למימר שהות לא הוה להו? מאן לימא לן דלא הדרי לאלתר:
Rashi on Niddah 45a:6:1.english: And who will say to us - That is to say: Even if you say that [the hymen] disappears upon intercourse within three [years], can one say that there was not enough time for it [to return]? Who will say to us that it does not return immediately?

Rashi on Niddah 45a:7:1.english: This is menstrual blood - This [refers to the blood emitted] within three [years].

Tosafot on Niddah 45a:16:1.english: What is my [status] regarding the priesthood - [The case was] that she had engaged in intercourse with [a man] disqualified to her.

Tosafot on Niddah 45a:6:1.hebrew: אחר בא עליה - ואם אשת כהן היא, אסורה; אבל אשת ישראל לא, דפיתוי קטנה אונס הוא. ואם תאמר: אמאי דחיק לאשכוחי נפקותא שבא עליה אחר לגבי זנות? לימא בפשיטות: כגון שבעל תוך שלשה ומצא דם, דאי לא מיתצדו, האי דם נדות הוא, כדאמר בסמוך! וי"ל, דניחא ליה לאשכוחי לענין זנות, דהויא כל ימיה אסורה לבעלה. ותו, דלענין אי הוה דם נדות או דם בתולין, לא נפקא מינה האידנא מידי, דאפילו הוא דם בתולים, הא תקון דבועל בעילת מצוה ופורש:
Tosafot on Niddah 45a:6:1.english: Another [man] engaged in intercourse with her - And [this applies only] if she is the wife of a priest (kohen), [in that] she is forbidden [to him]; but [if she is] the wife of an Israelite, [she is] not [forbidden], for the seduction of a minor is [deemed] rape (ones). And if you say: Why does [the Gemara] strain to find a practical difference [where] another [man] engaged in intercourse with her regarding [the prohibition of] illicit relations (zenut)? Let it say simply: for example, where [her husband] engaged in intercourse within three [years] and found blood, for if they [the virginity signs] are not removed, this [blood] is menstrual blood (dam niddut), as [the Gemara] says nearby! And one can say: It was preferable to it to find [a practical difference] regarding illicit relations (zenut), [since in that case] she is forbidden to her husband for all her days. And furthermore, regarding whether it is menstrual blood or virginity blood, there is no practical difference nowadays at all, for even if it is virginity blood, behold they instituted that one engages in the intercourse of the mitzvah (be'ilat mitzvah) and separates [immediately].

Tosafot on Niddah 45a:7:1.hebrew: האי דם נדה הוא - פירוש: הך דתוך ג', דהך דלאחר ג' לכ"ע הוי דם בתולין. ותימה, דאמאי נקט כלל שבעל אחר ג', כיון דלא נפקא מינה מידי? ופירש ר"ת, משום דנקטיה לעיל נקטיה נמי הכא. ומיהו י"ל, אף דם שלאחר ג' יש להסתפק בדם נדה, אי אמרינן איתצודי הוא דלא מיתצוד: כיון דבתוך ג' ראתה ודאי דם נדות, אם כן דרכה לראות מחמת חימוד בעילה; אם כן, גם אחר ג' יש להסתפק בדם נדה. ובתשובה אחת פרש"י, ד"איתצודי הוא דלא מיתצוד" דקאמר, היינו דלא שכיח הוא דמיתצוד, אבל כי איתצודי תו לא הדרי. וקאמר דנפקא מינה, דבעל תוך ג' ומצא דם, ואחר ג' לא מצא: דאי לא איתצוד — האי אחר בא עליה, דליכא אלא ספיקא אחת: דאי דם בתולין היה תוך ג' — מותרת, ואם דם נדה היה — הרי היא זונה. והדר קאמר שבעל ומצא דם תוך ג' ואחר ג', דאיכא לספוקי בתרווייהו בדם נדה: דאי בתוך ג' דם בתולין — אחר ג' דם נדה, דהא לא הדרי; ואי תוך ג' דם נדה הוא — אחר ג' דם בתולין. וקשה לפי זה: דאמאי לא אשכחן לענין זנות דמצא דם תוך ג' ושוב לא בעל עד י"ב שנים ולא מצא דם? דאי מיזל ואתו — האי אחר בא עליה; אע"ג דספק בא עליה אחר בקטנות או בגדלות, כיון דספקא אחת היא, אסורה אף לבעלה ישראל. ואי אתצודי לא מיתצוד — שריא לבעלה ישראל, דאימור דם דתוך ג' דם בתולין הוה; ואפי' אי הוה דם נדות, אימר אחר בא עליה בקטנות ואונס הוה. וי"ל, דאין רגילות שישהא עד י"ב שנה מלבא על אשתו:
Tosafot on Niddah 45a:7:1.english: This is menstrual blood - [This means] that of within three [years]; for that of after three [years] is virginity blood according to everyone. And it is astounding: Why did [the Gemara] mention at all that he engaged in intercourse after three [years], since no [practical difference] emerges from it? And Rabbeinu Tam explained: Because it mentioned it above, it mentioned it here as well. However, it can be said: Even regarding the blood [emitted] after three [years], there is reason to doubt whether it is menstrual blood, if we say that it is not removed [until after three]. For since within three [years] she definitely saw menstrual blood, if so, her nature is to see [blood] due to arousal from intercourse; if so, after three [years] as well there is reason to doubt whether it is menstrual blood. And in one responsum, Rashi explained that "it is not removed" which [the Gemara] states means that it is not common for it to be removed, but when it is removed, it does not return. And [Rashi] said that the practical difference is where he engaged in intercourse within three [years] and found blood, and after three [years] he did not find [blood]: For if it was not removed, another [man] engaged in intercourse with her, as there is only a single doubt: For if the blood within three [years] was virginity blood, she is permitted; and if it was menstrual blood, she is a zona [and forbidden to her husband, a priest]. And then [the Gemara] states [a case] where he engaged in intercourse and found blood within three [years] and after three [years], for there is reason to doubt regarding both of them whether it is menstrual blood: For if within three [years] it was virginity blood, after three [years] it is menstrual blood, since they do not return; and if within three [years] it was menstrual blood, after three [years] it is virginity blood. And it is difficult according to this: Why did [the Gemara] not find [a case of practical difference] regarding [the prohibition of] zenut where he found blood within three [years], and did not engage in intercourse again until twelve years [of age], and did not find blood? For if they disappear and come back, another [man] engaged in intercourse with her; [and] even though it is uncertain whether another [man] engaged in intercourse with her during [her] minority or during [her] majority, since it is a single doubt, she is forbidden even to her husband [who is] an Israelite. But if it is not removed, she is permitted to her husband [who is] an Israelite: For one can say that the blood within three [years] was virginity blood; and even if it was menstrual blood, one can say that another [man] engaged in intercourse with her during [her] minority, and it was rape (ones)! And it can be answered: It is not usual for [a man] to wait until twelve years [of age] without engaging in intercourse with his wife.

Tosafot on Niddah 45a:9:1.hebrew: בת י"ג שנים ויום א' - תימה, דלקמן תניא אלו דברי רבי אמתני' דקתני בת י"ב ויום אחד נדרה נדר. ויש ספרים דגרסי בת י"ב ויום אחד. ואי גרסינן בת י"ד שנה בלא יום אחד, אתי שפיר; ומתעברת ויולדת קאמר, ושנת י"ג אין צריך להיות שלם:
Tosafot on Niddah 45a:9:1.english: A girl of thirteen years and one day - [This is] astonishing, for below (45b) it is taught [in a baraita]: "These are the words of Rabbi" on the Mishnah, which teaches: "A girl of twelve [years] and one day, her vow is a [valid] vow." And there are books that read: "A girl of twelve [years] and one day." And if we read: "A girl of fourteen years minus one day," it works out well; [for] he meant [the age at which she] conceives and gives birth, and the thirteenth year does not need to be complete.
